description: Security hardening across code + SAM template (Tasks: CORS, name length 50, WS session required, DynamoDB SSE, WAF rate limiting). Threads an AllowedOrigin SAM parameter into REST CORS and the register handler's response headers, reconciles name length to 50 chars in lib.js/register.html/tests, makes the WS session requirement explicit + tested, adds DynamoDB SSE, and adds a WAFv2 WebACL rate-based rule (100 req/5min/IP) associated with the REST API stage. Must keep `sam validate --lint` clean (no E-errors, no circular dependency E3004).
steps: NAME LENGTH — In src/lib.js change MAX_NAME_LENGTH from 30 to 50 (validateName already uses the constant and the error message interpolates it, so no other logic change needed). In register.html change the input maxlength="30" to maxlength="50", change the JS guard `if (name.length > 30)` to `> 50`, and update the user-facing message '(max 30)' to '(max 50)'. In src/lib.test.js the too-long test uses MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 1 so it stays correct; additionally add an assertion that a 50-char name is accepted and a 51-char name is rejected to lock the boundary.

CORS PARAMETER — In template.yaml add a Parameters section (or extend it) with AllowedOrigin: Type: String, Default: '*', Description mentioning it should be set to the CloudFront origin (e.g. https://d3b9hppiarktsx.cloudfront.net) in production. Thread it into RestApi Cors AllowOrigin: use `!Sub "'${AllowedOrigin}'"` so the value is single-quoted as API Gateway CORS requires. Pass ALLOWED_ORIGIN as an environment variable to RegisterFunction (Environment.Variables.ALLOWED_ORIGIN: !Ref AllowedOrigin).

CORS IN CODE — In src/lib.js update jsonResponse to read the allowed origin from process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN (fallback to '*' when unset, so tests and local use keep working) and set 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' to that value instead of the hardcoded '*'. Keep the other CORS headers. Update the src/lib.test.js jsonResponse test so it still passes: with ALLOWED_ORIGIN unset it should be '*'; optionally add a case that sets process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN to a URL and asserts the header reflects it (restore/delete the env var after).

WS SESSION REQUIRED — src/ws-connect.js already refuses connections without ?session= (returns 400). Make it explicit: keep the refusal, and (via the logger added in FEAT-003, or console.warn if FEAT-003 not yet applied) log a warn 'connect_no_session' before returning 400. Add a small unit-testable helper OR a test that documents the contract. Since ws-connect imports AWS, prefer adding a test that requires ws-connect and invokes exports.handler with an event lacking queryStringParameters.session and asserts statusCode===400 and that addConnection is NOT called — to avoid real AWS, the coder may inject/stub aws.addConnection (e.g., monkey-patch the required module's export) or extract the session check into lib.js as a pure function `requireSession(event)` and test that. Choose the lower-risk approach that keeps `node --test` green without network/credentials.
DYNAMODB SSE — In template.yaml add to BOTH RegistrationsTable and ConnectionsTable Properties: SSESpecification: { SSEEnabled: true }.

WAF — In template.yaml add an AWS::WAFv2::WebACL named e.g. RegistrationWebAcl with Scope: REGIONAL, DefaultAction: { Allow: {} }, VisibilityConfig (SampledRequestsEnabled true, CloudWatchMetricsEnabled true, MetricName e.g. 'spinning-wheel-web-acl'), and one Rule: a rate-based rule (Name 'RateLimitPerIP', Priority 0, Action { Block: {} }, Statement.RateBasedStatement { Limit: 100, EvaluationWindowSec: 300, AggregateKeyType: IP }, its own VisibilityConfig). NOTE: WAFv2 RateBasedStatement Limit minimum historically was 100 and EvaluationWindowSec supports 300 (5 min) — verify these are accepted by `sam validate --lint`; if EvaluationWindowSec is rejected by the linter, omit it (default window is 5 minutes = 300s, which matches the requirement). Add an AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation with ResourceArn pointing at the REST API stage (construct the stage ARN via !Sub, referencing the RestApi and its Stage; for AWS::Serverless::Api the stage is <RestApi>.Stage — the association ResourceArn form is `arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/restapis/${RestApi}/stages/prod`) and WebACLArn: !GetAtt RegistrationWebAcl.Arn. Keep the StageName 'prod' literal consistent with the existing template. Ensure this does not introduce a circular dependency.

Run `sam validate --lint` and iterate until clean (no E-errors). If the WAFv2 property shapes cause lint errors, adjust to the linter-accepted schema while preserving the intent (REGIONAL scope, rate limit 100 per 5 min per IP, associated to the REST stage).
node --check all changed src/*.js; run `sam build`; run `node --test`.
acceptance_criteria: MAX_NAME_LENGTH is 50; register.html maxlength=50 and JS guard/message reference 50; tests assert 50 accepted / 51 rejected

template.yaml has an AllowedOrigin parameter (default '*') threaded into RestApi Cors AllowOrigin and passed as ALLOWED_ORIGIN env to RegisterFunction; jsonResponse uses process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN with '*' fallback
ws-connect refusal of session-less connections is explicit and covered by a test or extracted pure helper; test suite stays green without AWS credentials
Both DynamoDB tables have SSESpecification SSEEnabled: true
template.yaml has a WAFv2 REGIONAL WebACL with a rate-based rule (100 / 5 min / IP) and a WebACLAssociation to the REST API prod stage
`sam validate --lint` passes with no E-errors (no E3004 circular dependency)
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/spinning-wheel && node --check src/lib.js && node --test
export PATH="/projects/sandbox/.samvenv/bin:$PATH"; cd /projects/sandbox/spinning-wheel; sam validate --lint && sam build
findings: Implemented all six security items. NAME LENGTH: MAX_NAME_LENGTH 30->50 in src/lib.js; register.html maxlength=50, JS guard >50, message '(max 50)'; added lib.test.js boundary assertions (50 accepted, 51 rejected). CORS: added AllowedOrigin SAM Parameter (default '*'), threaded into RestApi Cors AllowOrigin via !Sub "'${AllowedOrigin}'" (single-quoted per API Gateway), passed ALLOWED_ORIGIN env to RegisterFunction; jsonResponse now reads process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN with '*' fallback; added a test that verifies the env override and restores it. WS SESSION: chose the pure-helper approach (extracted requireSession(event) into lib.js) because ws-connect requires ./aws which imports @aws-sdk/* modules that are NOT installed in node_modules on the host (only resolved during `sam build`), so requiring ws-connect in `node --test` fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. requireSession is unit-tested (session present ok; missing/empty refused). ws-connect.js now uses requireSession and logs a WARN 'connect_no_session' before returning 400. DYNAMODB SSE: SSESpecification { SSEEnabled: true } added to both tables. WAF: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL (REGIONAL, DefaultAction Allow, one RateBasedStatement rule Block, Limit 100, AggregateKeyType IP) + WebACLAssociation to arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/restapis/${RestApi}/stages/prod. EvaluationWindowSec: 300 WAS accepted by `sam validate --lint`, so it is kept. VERIFICATION: node --check clean on changed src/*.js; node --test = 23 pass / 0 fail (was 15, +8 across new/updated assertions; wheel-logic tests included in run); `sam validate --lint` = valid template, no E3004 circular dependency; `sam build` = Build Succeeded. NOTE: node/npm and sam build require `unset NODE_OPTIONS` (stale NODE_OPTIONS points at a missing preload module) — sam build fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on proxy-bootstrap.js without it. Preserved literal 'prod' in WS_ENDPOINT env vars as required.
